purpose: Published routes accepted as having no inbound internal link from a served page. This list is a RATCHET: a route in it that has since been linked is reported as stale and must be removed, and a route not in it is a hard failure. It may only shrink. Add a route only when the page is deliberately unreachable and the reason is written next to it; a page that merely has not been adopted yet belongs in the orphan-adoption queue, not here.
